structured_output.what_is_happening: Nomad Arena (Arena) is a pump.fun coin about 22 minutes old. It rose about 1000% to roughly $41k market cap on about $80k volume, with 753 unique buyers against 450 sellers, and it is near the end of the bonding curve (104 of 115 virtual SOL). The project site nomadarena.live describes a cross-chain AI-agent trading arena and lists this exact contract address. The creator's wallet has sold out (GMGN status creator_close). GMGN flags 127 bundler wallets holding about 25% among top traders, plus 191 fresh wallets. Price is about 23% below its all-time high of about $53k.

narrative.description: A 'utility' pitch: six AI trading agents compete across Robinhood, pump.fun, Base and BNB. This fits the ongoing AI-agent trading-arena meta (Alpha Arena/nof1, Virtuals Arena). The site shows $60k 'NAV' but zero trades so far.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely pump.fun front-page momentum and the approach to migration. Searches found no organic X, Reddit or news discussion.

token_connection.why_this_token: The project website names this contract address as its token. The coin uses a custom vanity address rather than the usual pump suffix, which points to a deliberate launch.
token_connection.competing_tokens: A 'Nomad Arena' token with ticker NOMAD (FMkz...pump) launched about an hour earlier and died at $3.4k. Many unrelated ARENA tickers exist, including Arena at $6.7M and Arena of Memes.

authenticity.evidence: 753 unique buyers in 30 minutes is a real crowd. But GMGN flags 127 bundlers (about 25% of top traders), 191 fresh wallets and a 39% bot/degen rate, and the dev has sold out. There are no paid DexScreener boosts. Smart wallets: 6; renowned (KOL) wallets: 1.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X data. The Nomad_Arena_ X account and its posts were not found by search.
